description: Functional scope: versioned bounded migration/backfill maps each compatible AI credential to one dedicated Connect configuration and global grant with disabled policy, preserving API key or legacy OAuth status/material/expiry without reactivation; associate atomically. Tests first: idempotent rerun, partial failure/resume, naming collisions, concurrent source edit, encrypted storage/no logging, revoked/expired OAuth preservation, rollback/down guard. Branches: API key, OAuth, explicit no-auth, unresolved preflight. Mocking: real Repo/encryption. Docs: deployment order/recovery. Action reuse: reuse canonical Mutations and OAuth storage contracts; migration orchestration stays operator-only/local, never agent-exposed.
title: [zaq-jrg.25] Restartable AI credential backfill
